title: Julian Jaynes' bicameral mind theory: a shift in consciousness after 1000 BC

tellings.quote: there's a guy named Julian James. I don't know if you've heard of him. He was a um Yale professor. He wrote a book called um uh on the origins of consciousness and the bicamal mind.

plain: A Yale professor named Julian Jaynes argued that human consciousness changed after about 1000 BC, moving away from what he called a "bicameral," or two-chambered, mind. Michels brings it up himself with a guest, naming Jaynes's book The Origin of Consciousness in the Breakdown of the Bicameral Mind, as a way to think about how ancient people may have experienced the world differently.
